stages.title: Register four immutable 12-stage plans
stages.gate: Four normalized plan hashes are recorded and each current plan status is AWAITING_APPROVAL.

commands.note: Read-only structural tests for the cumulative v2 gate.

stages.title: Human approval of all four normalized plan hashes
stages.gate: The author explicitly approves the exact four registered SHA-256 values before any harness run.

stages.title: Locked identity, claim boundary and verified literature
stages.gate: Titles and authors are exact; every retained reference passes existence, metadata and citation-context checks and is mapped to a claim.

stages.title: Method, data, implementation and experiment freeze
stages.gate: Each paper has a machine-readable FROZEN protocol, provenance manifest, environment, runbook and planned-versus-executed ledger.

stages.title: Non-confirmatory pilot and activation decision
stages.gate: Pilot passes code, data, leakage, budget and resource checks and remains explicitly excluded from paper evidence.

stages.title: Immutable formal experiments and statistical audit
stages.gate: Formal run manifests, raw results, primary results, negative results, claim evidence and statistical audits are complete.

stages.title: Evidence-first section reconstruction
stages.gate: Every numerical and causal sentence is traceable; abstract and conclusion are written last and do not exceed the evidence ledger.

stages.title: Mandatory ARS Stage 2.5 integrity gate
stages.gate: References, statistics, originality, claim consistency and seven AI-research failure modes pass before review.

stages.title: Five-view adversarial review
stages.gate: JF, R1, R2, R3 and DA reviewers produce one evidence-anchored revision roadmap.

stages.title: Bounded revision and independent re-review
stages.gate: Every concern is answered and independently rechecked against original and revised hashes within two full loops.

stages.title: Final integrity, writing regression and PDF inspection
stages.gate: Citation context is 100 percent checked; figures and tables trace to data; prose has no numerical, citation or claim-strength regression; PDFs pass visual QA.

stages.title: Hashed reproducibility packages and human submission
stages.gate: All package hashes pass and the corresponding author confirms declarations, rights, target and external submission.

hard_rules: The four locked titles must remain byte-for-byte identical to the author-provided text.
Do not invent datasets, citations, numerical outcomes, expert judgments, funding, CRediT roles or rights statements.
Pilot results are non-confirmatory and must not enter manuscript conclusions.
Legacy evidence is read-only; every formal rerun uses a new immutable namespace.
Negative, failed, null and ranking-reversal results remain visible in evidence and prose.
A title-method mismatch triggers NO-GO rather than narrative relabeling.
No automatic email or journal submission is permitted.
manual_gates: Approve the four normalized plan SHA-256 values before execution.
Confirm data provenance, licences and any confidential project-cost or grid records before use.
Confirm CRediT roles, funding, conflicts, acknowledgements, repository scope and rights.
Reconfirm current journal scope, template, APC and submission requirements immediately before release.
Perform final author read and corresponding-author approval before external submission.
